st.stale: This couldn't be refreshed, so what you see may be out of date.
st.err.generic: Something went wrong and this didn't go through. Try again. If it keeps happening, use “Report a problem”.
st.err.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet, then try again.
st.err.permissionDenied: Your account isn't allowed to do this. If your role changed a moment ago, sign out and sign in again.
st.err.unavailable: The service can't be reached right now. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
st.err.notFound: This isn't there any more. Reload the page to see what there is now.
st.err.resourceExhausted: Too many requests just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
st.err.deadlineExceeded: This took too long and was stopped. Check your connection and try again.
st.err.unauthenticated: You're signed out. Sign in again, then try once more.
st.err.failedPrecondition: This can't be done as things are now. Reload the page, check, and try again.
st.err.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, use “Report a problem”.
st.err.invalidArgument: Something that was sent wasn't accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
st.err.storageUnauthorized: Your account isn't allowed to open or save this file. If your role changed a moment ago, sign out and sign in again.
st.err.storageQuota: The file storage is full for now. Try again later, or tell a platform admin.
st.err.storageRetry: The file didn't go through because the connection kept dropping. Check your connection and try again.
st.rf.orgSuspended: This organization is suspended, so nothing in it can be changed. A platform admin can resume it.
st.rf.orgDeleting: This organization is being deleted, so nothing in it can be changed.
st.rf.codeExpired: This invite code has expired. Ask the organization's admin for a new one.
st.rf.codeUsedUp: This invite code has been used as many times as it allows. Ask the organization's admin for a new one.
st.rf.removed: The organization removed this account. One of its admins has to let it back in first.
st.rf.emailUnverified: The email address has to be confirmed first: open the link in the confirmation email, then try again.
st.rf.emailDomain: This organization only accepts its own email addresses. Sign in with an address the organization gave.
st.rf.badPolicy: Check the email domains (at most 20, like school.edu), the expiry (a time still to come) and the number of uses (1 or more).
st.rf.notInOrg: This account doesn't belong to an organization.
st.rf.managed: The organization made this account, so it can't leave by itself: one of the organization's admins removes it.
st.rf.selfSuspend: You can't suspend or restore your own account. Another admin can.
st.rf.platformSuspended: A platform admin suspended this account, and only a platform admin can restore it.
st.rf.tooMany: Too many people at once. Choose 200 or fewer.
st.rf.badAction: This action isn't known to the server. Reload the page and try again.
st.rf.badTeacher: Choose a teacher or an admin of this organization.
st.rf.noLicence: This organization has no Darsi Super licence, or its licence has ended. Its admin can buy seats, or a platform admin can give a licence.
st.rf.seatsFull: Every seat is taken. Free a seat, or add seats to the licence.
st.rf.badSeats: Seats must be a whole number from 1 to 100,000.
st.rf.badDays: Days must be a whole number, 1 or more (at most 3,660 for one person).
st.rf.badCredits: Credits must be a whole number from 1 to 100,000.
st.rf.badArgs: Something was missing from the request. Reload the page and try again.
st.rf.recentLogin: This needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out, sign in again, and try once more within 10 minutes.
st.rf.disabled: This account is suspended, so it can't do this. Ask the organization's admin, or use “Report a problem” if you think it is a mistake.
st.rf.noGrant: You don't have access to this course's results, or the access has ended. A platform admin can give it.
st.rf.badOrgs: Choose between 1 and 20 organizations. If one of them was deleted, reload the page and choose again.
st.rf.badUntil: The end date has to be in the future, and at most ten years away.
st.rf.badUnitId: This course ID isn't valid. Use small letters, numbers and dashes.
st.rf.noUnit: This course isn't there any more. Reload the list.
st.rf.noOwner: This course has no valid owner, so it can't be changed here. Tell a platform admin.
st.rf.notUnitAdmin: Only this course's admins can do that.
st.rf.draftId: The draft's ID doesn't match its course. Reload the editor and try again.
st.rf.draftInvalid: The course has errors. Fix them in the editor first, then publish.
st.rf.catalogPending: Saved, but the course list couldn't be updated just now. It will follow by itself within 15 minutes: there is nothing to do again.
st.rf.badPeriods: Each period is a whole number of days from 1 to 3,650, or empty.
st.rf.noReport: That report isn't there any more. Reload the list.
st.rf.legalText: Each language's text is plain text of at most 60,000 characters, and the English text is needed before publishing.
st.rf.legalVersion: That isn't the version published now. Reload the page to read the current one.
st.rf.badGa: A measurement ID looks like G-ABC123XYZ, and the API secret has at most 100 characters.
st.rf.badStatus: Only an active organization can be suspended, and a suspended one can only be resumed. One that is being deleted can't be changed.
st.rf.failed: This one didn't go through. Try it again.
st.rf.tryAgain: Your account couldn't be checked just now. Try again in a moment.
st.rf.noOrg: That organization isn't there any more, or none was chosen. Reload the page and choose one from the list.
st.rf.noAccount: This account isn't there any more. Reload the page to see who is.
st.rf.notSuper: Only platform admins can do that. If you were made one a moment ago, sign out and sign in again.
st.rf.legalDoc: The server didn't know which page this is, or was asked to publish and unpublish at once. Reload the page and try again.
st.rf.legalFile: Saved, but the copy everyone reads couldn't be written. Publish or unpublish again.
st.rf.badGaSecret: The API secret is too long: it has at most 100 characters. Copy it again from Google Analytics, with no spaces around it.
st.rf.badMembers: Choose what happens to the members: let them go, or delete the accounts the organization made. Then start again.
st.rf.deleteOption: This deletion was started with the other choice for its members, and it goes on that way. Choose that one, then continue.
st.rf.deleteOptionRelease: This deletion was started with “Release its people”, and it goes on that way. Choose that again, then continue.
st.rf.deleteOptionManaged: This deletion was started with “Delete the accounts the organization made”, and it goes on that way. Choose that again, then continue.
st.rf.exportWait: An export of this organization started a few minutes ago. A new one can start at {time}.
st.rf.exportWaitSoon: An export of this organization started a few minutes ago. Wait a few minutes, then start a new one.
st.rf.badPage: That isn't a page Darsi can read. Reload the page builder and try again.
st.rf.pageTooLong: The page is too long. Remove some blocks or shorten the texts.
st.rf.pageProblems: Fix what is marked on the page first.
st.rf.dataWait: A download of this account's data was started a few minutes ago. Wait ten minutes, then try again.
st.rf.badCode: That code isn't valid. Check it with the organization's admin.
st.rf.inOrg: This account already belongs to an organization. It has to leave that one first.
st.rf.tooManyTries: Too many wrong codes. Try again in an hour.
st.rf.reserved: This kind of login is only for accounts an organization makes. Sign in with your own email to do this.
st.rf.pendingRequest: There is already a request waiting for review. A platform admin answers it first.
st.rf.reviewed: This request was already reviewed. Reload the list.
st.rf.requesterInOrg: The person who asked now belongs to another organization: reject this request instead.
st.rf.requesterStaff: The person who asked is a platform admin: reject this request instead.
st.rf.passwordUnchanged: Choose a new password first: it has to differ from the one you were given.
st.rf.badCursor: The deletion lost its place. Start it again: what was already done stays done.
st.rf.badExport: The export lost its place. Start the export again.
st.rf.badUids: The list of people wasn't valid. Reload the page, choose them again and try once more.
st.rf.badPatch: This change can't be saved as it is. Reload the page and try again.
st.rf.badGroup: A class name has at most 60 characters.
st.rf.nameOne: A name can be changed for one person at a time.
st.rf.badUnit: Choose a course from the list.
st.rf.changed: Someone saved this after you opened it. Reload it, check it, then try again.
st.rf.siteTaken: That address belongs to another organization.
st.rf.ssoLogin: This person signs in through the school's own sign-in, so the account has no Darsi password to reset. A login that doesn't work is mended at the school.
st.rf.ssoOwnLogin: You are signed in through your school. Sign in with your own Darsi login (email and password, or Google) to do this.
st.rf.ssoLastWayIn: That would leave the organization with no admin who can sign in without the school's sign-in. Give one admin a password or a Google login first.
st.acc.orgsHint: Choose none, and they see only the students of the organization they belong to when you save (or people in no organization, if they belong to none). That stays so if they later leave it or join another. At most 20.
st.acc.orgsUnset: None set, so they see no one. Save this access again to set them.
st.acc.untilHint: Leave empty, and the access stays until you remove it.
st.acc.removeBody: They stop seeing these courses' results at once. You can give access again later.
st.res.more: This course has more results than one page can show, so some students or projects may be missing here.
